answer.rationale: Finance mandates an 18% cost cut, but the incumbent refuses to reopen pricing. Switching primary vendor (per memory_c2) would achieve sharp cost reductions but increases delivery risk, violating the core constraint of 'without increasing delivery risk.' Renewal or deferral cannot meet the cost mandate. Adding a second source (per memory_c3) eliminates single points of failure and maintains supply through shortages, directly reducing delivery risk while creating competitive leverage to drive cost reductions over time. A small-scale test addition is executable within the 14-day window and aligns with minimizing TCO without increasing risk.
